requirements: RC39 real testnet acceptance prerequisite; no replay of uncertain financial actions

checks.scope: Actual disposable Ethers signatures with labelled controlled receipts/providers; no network sends or project credentials.

analysis: Strict closed successor input binds original plan digest and approval hash plus first cancellation signed hash and reconstructed journal identity digest. Both original and first signed transaction bytes are verified before admission.

Same sender/Sepolia chain/same nonce/self-recipient/zero value/empty calldata/21000 gas are reconstructed, not caller-configurable. Both successor fee caps exceed first cancellation caps and maxFee remains strictly below5gwei. New signing window is future and no more than24hours; original expired funding plan is not extended.

Separate fixed successor journal and existing sender lock preserve original two journals. Preparing is persisted before signing and signed bytes before transport. Existing preparing/unknown record only reconciles, even after expiry; no automatic replacement loop or old-byte replay.

Preflight retains canonical code, sender nonces, balance/future reserve, estimate and deadline checks. All known finalized winners are reread before signing and after submission; original approval winner must satisfy its actual allowance effect. Nonfinal/reorg/wrong-effect/failed/conflicting outcomes cannot unlock continuation.

Continuation requires succeeded+canonical winner, binds successor in new identity, preserves inventory/FEE prefix and starts next nonce. USDC approval is skipped only for original approval winner; either cancellation winner requires it.

CLI parses explicit successor command and optional continuation successor, uses private input reader/existing protected journal ownership and key-reference flow; no plugin/model or generated-code authority added.

Existing tests inspect real signed envelope, persisted once-only boundaries, expiry/malformed binding, both prior winners racing preflight, lost acknowledgement, no repeated sign/broadcast, all three winners and failed/reorg/conflicting effects. Assertions remain and new cases augment them.
limits: Approval is source/component review, not instruction to repeat any uncertain transaction. Lead must select explicit fresh fees and reconcile current live state before the separately authorized one-shot action.
Fee increase does not guarantee provider replacement acceptance. A new unknown outcome remains fenced; this code does not authorize another successor.
Actual canonical nonce winner and continued funding/prover/testnet application acceptance remain unproven by these tests.
Candidate is worker source; final integration composition must preserve these exact blobs and applicable checks.
